title: MemoryEvidence
description: Tamper-evident memory read/write record. Each op records the content digest of the memory cell plus the digest observed immediately before the op (prior_digest), so successive records form a hash chain: altering any past write changes its digest and breaks the chain at the next read/write, making tamper detectable. Records are linked into AEP actions via aep-record's memory_read_refs / memory_write_refs.

mem_ref.description: Stable reference (key/path) to the memory cell that was read or written

op.description: Memory operation performed against the referenced cell

digest.description: Content digest of the memory cell — post-write content for a write, or the value returned by a read

prior_digest.description: Digest of the memory cell's content immediately before this op. Null when the cell did not previously exist (first write / creation). Carries the hash-chain link that makes the record tamper-evident.

timestamp_ms.description: UTC epoch milliseconds when the memory op was recorded
